verdict.rationale: A paper, mail or in-person fallback is a fair question for a government online-incorporation service, so the axis applies. However, every documented step is digital: Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital authentication, in-platform digital signing of the pacto social, online payment, and email delivery of results. No evidence publishes postal addresses, fax numbers, paper forms or counter locations as an alternative when the online flow is unavailable.
